g.text: in the middle of a line is
starts with 4, 4.2, 4.2.1 or A.1, then text
text ≤ 100 characters, no final full stop
at least half its words capitalised
at least 4 letters, every letter uppercase
only letters, digits, space, / & , - ( ) and a final :
text up to the next heading
Checks: university slug, non-empty section text,
policy type + format from fixed lists, valid date
text 'A student must strive to attend …'
Flat sections: 4.2.1 is its own section, not nested under 4.2
